newsitem.title: POLAND: Izolacja seen extending debut gain.
newsitem.headline: Izolacja seen extending debut gain.

text.p: Polish insulation material maker Izolacja SA started trade on the bourse's main market at 165.5 zlotys, 37.9 percent above issue and analysts said the company's ratios signalled some upside potential.

Analysts said the stock was trading at 12.8 times prospective 1997 earnings, which made it slightly cheaper than the overall market valued at 14 times prospective earnings and the construction sector trading at about 20.
"Taking into account it's a cool season on the bourse the debut price is quite good and I see some upside potential in the stock, not too strong but just some," one trader said.
Some said Izolacja was likely to rise to 180 zlotys in the next few sessions.
